usedFor: The team hears about each new Calendly booking in a Slack channel.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Each booking in Calendly gives the team something to post, and “Send Message” can target a channel, user or thread.

watchOut: The first Calendly post to a Slack channel needs an approval tap.
